title: BC Ferries
subtitle: A visual identity timeline
scope: Two principal symbol families; three representative presentations. Not an exhaustive application or anniversary-mark catalogue.

sources.title: New BC Ferry Company to Improve Services
sources.publisher: BC Ferry Services Inc. / Government of British Columbia
sources.evidence: Contemporary announcement: dogwood retired after 43 years; outgoing logo unchanged for 25 years; wave introduced; fleet rollout planned over the following year.

sources.title: British Columbia Toll Authority Ferry System — 1963 season brochure
sources.publisher: British Columbia Toll Authority Ferry System; scan hosted by ExploreNorth
sources.evidence: Original brochure cover shows a softer black-outlined dogwood on a green waving flag. This is a dated usage example, not a launch announcement.

sources.title: Investor Overview — September 2026
sources.evidence: Current wave-and-wordmark visible on cover; checks continuity of the identity through September 2026.

stages.name: The early dogwood

A 1963 brochure shows a softer flower,
outlined in black on a green flag.
